#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. 

Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow's technology. As a Staff Engineer Product Development for Power MOSFETs in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. 

Are you in?

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape the future of high-voltage power MOSFETs (Si and SiC)? Would you like to take an active role in driving their development-and potentially expand into innovative multicomponent solutions such as switch-and-driver IC combinations? As a new member of our team, you will contribute to product development projects across multiple sites and take ownership of technical work packages, including the design and verification of your own products. You will collaborate with international colleagues from around the world, exchange ideas, and help turn technical concepts into successful products. 

 * Actively contribute to the product innovation process with concepts, demonstrators and technical evaluation and collaborate as a technical team member in new wafer technology, package and product projects

 * Solve product issues and explore improvements for future product or technology releases by applying your semiconductor physics knowledge

 * Actively contribute to product design and process DOEs to ensure manufacturability and attractive product performance

 * Collaborate with product marketing and application engineering to shape products for business success

 * Define the electrical characterization of the developed components, evaluate the results and discuss within an expert community

 * Support qualification, failure analysis and troubleshooting activities through interpretation of electrical and physical analysis (e.g. SEM, X-ray, EMMI) during reliability tests

 * Support the product evaluation activities in transfer projects between production sites

 * Be an active part of our technical community by contributing with your know-how to the knowledge pool but also benefiting from the network of experts for your own learning and growth

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A technical university degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics or similar

 * 3+ years of relevant work or PhD research experience in the field of semiconductors - ideally in product development/engineering

 * Strong device physics knowledge of semiconductor devices and power switches (Si and SiC); Wide Bandgab (WBG) know-how is highly valued

 * Solid skills in electric data analysis and basic knowledge of statistics

 * First experience with power devices specifications and datasheets 

 * Proven capability of technical problem solving

 * Lab experience, ideally related to the characterization of semiconductor devices, is a plus

 * Very good communication skills in English, German skills are a plus

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group G (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.

 * You advance our software development with a high dedication to quality and a high commitment to well-tested and documented applications.
 * You also share your expertise with junior developers, offering strategic guidance in software requirements analysis, system design and structuring modular tasks.
 * With your interest in the newest technological developments, you advance our research projects and help establish new business models and concepts in the field of advanced vision systems.

 * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate efficiently with clients and project managers, and to guide a development team
 * Strong skills in modern C++ and Python, with solid experience in Git, CMake and Linux environments. Experience with Qt/PySide, C#/.NET, MATLAB, CUDA or HPC is beneficial.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. You ensure the successful execution of projects from order intake to delivery, meeting targets for schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
